title: Inconsistent string replacement with hard tab indentation
body:
**Bug Description**
When I use hard tabs for indent, the string replacement tool seems to fail frequently. For a toy project I can change to spaces, but for a real project that's obviously not going to fly. Also, the build process includes a prettier rule to properly reformat files, which may also be a source of claude confusion.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: ssh-session
- Version: 0.2.45
- Feedback ID: b744ec68-9dc4-4633-b3b0-c0ce5efc67fa
